SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
AND site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member_dormant WHERE 1 = 1
AND site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_member_withdraw WHERE retention_expire_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
AND site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN di_hash IS NOT NULL AND di_hash != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified, SUM(CASE WHEN di_hash IS NULL OR di_hash = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unverified FROM tb_member WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
AND site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT m.site_id AS siteId, s.site_code AS siteCode, s.site_name AS siteName, COUNT(*) AS total FROM tb_member m JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id WHERE m.delete_yn = 'N' GROUP BY m.site_id, s.site_code, s.site_name ORDER BY total DESC
